questions.q:
With reference to the Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY), consider the following statements:
1. It was formed in 2021-22 by merging three earlier schemes.
2. Although a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, it is fully funded by the Centre.
3. A village qualifies for the Adarsh Gram component if more than 25 per cent of its population belongs to the Scheduled Castes.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the merged schemes were PMAGY, Special Central Assistance to the SC Sub Plan and the Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana. A village qualifies if its SC population exceeds 40 per cent and its total population is at least 500, so statement 3 is wrong. The ministry proposed continuing the scheme from 2026-27 to 2030-31.

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
Earlier scheme : Component of PM-AJAY it became
1. Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana : Adarsh Gram
2. Special Central Assistance to Scheduled Castes Sub Plan : Grants-in-Aid
3. Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana : Hostel
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: All three pairs are correct. Adarsh Gram gets up to half of the funds, with Rs 20 lakh per new village to saturate 50 indicators in 10 domains through a village development plan. Hostels in central institutions get up to 2 per cent, and administration up to 5 per cent. The AJAY mobile app of May 2026 enables geo-tagging and milestone-linked fund flow.

questions.q:
PM-AJAY draws its constitutional basis from which of the following?
1. Article 46
2. Article 38(2)
3. Article 17
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Article 46 directs the State to promote the educational and economic interests of weaker sections, especially SCs and STs, and Article 38(2) asks it to minimise inequalities of income, status and opportunity; both are Directive Principles. Article 17, which abolishes untouchability, is a Fundamental Right and is not cited as the scheme's basis.

questions.q: Under PM-AJAY, at least what share of grants to States must be used exclusively for income-generating schemes for Scheduled Caste women?
questions.e: At least 15 per cent of grants are reserved for viable income-generating schemes for SC women, and women must make up at least 30 per cent of skill-development trainees. At least 10 per cent of total funds go to skill development, and North-Eastern States get 2 per cent of the allocation.

questions.q:
With reference to PM-Vidyalaxmi, consider the following statements:
1. It offers collateral-free and guarantor-free education loans to students admitted to quality higher education institutions.
2. The 3 per cent interest subvention is available only to students from families earning up to Rs 8 lakh a year.
3. It is a Central Sector Scheme with Canara Bank as its nodal bank.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: All three statements are correct. PM-Vidyalaxmi is a Central Sector Scheme of the Ministry of Education with Rs 3,600 crore for 2024-25 to 2030-31. Coverage has grown from 860 to 1,425 institutions, chosen by NIRF ranking. Loans are open to students of all income groups; the Rs 8 lakh ceiling applies only to the 3 per cent subvention.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Interest subvention under PM-Vidyalaxmi is credited through a central bank digital currency wallet.
Statement-II: Students apply through a single Common Education Loan Application Form on the scheme's portal.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Both statements are correct, but they describe separate features. Subvention reaches students through the PM Vidyalaxmi Digital Rupee App, a CBDC wallet; the common application form lets a student apply to up to three banks and track status. Benefits are available only once and stop on dropping out, except for documented medical reasons.

questions.q: The PM-USP Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme, which PM-Vidyalaxmi supplements, provides
o: a 3 per cent interest subvention for family incomes up to Rs 8 lakh
a credit guarantee for all education loans
full interest subsidy during the moratorium for family incomes up to Rs 4.5 lakh for technical and professional courses
questions.e: The older scheme covers poorer students fully, while PM-Vidyalaxmi's partial subvention reaches families earning up to Rs 8 lakh. The Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Education Loans provides guarantees, and the National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company manages the guarantee fund under PM-Vidyalaxmi.

questions.q:
With reference to the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, consider the following statements:
1. The Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) is the 12-digit Aadhaar number used as a health identifier.
2. All patient records are stored in a single central repository run by the National Health Authority.
3. The Unified Health Interface is a closed network open only to government hospitals.
How many of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: None of the statements is correct. ABHA is a separate 14-digit identifier, which can be created with or without Aadhaar. Records stay with the provider that created them and are shared only with consent, with no central repository. The Unified Health Interface is an open network modelled on UPI, for public and private providers. Over 104 crore records were linked by 2026.

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs:
ABDM tool : Description
1. eSushrut@Clinic : Lightweight hospital management system developed by C-DAC for small facilities
2. National Health Claims Exchange : Platform linking insurers, hospitals and regulators for claims
3. BODH : Benchmarking platform for health AI using federated learning
4. Scan and Share : Developed by ICMR for vaccine certificates
How many of the above pairs are correctly matched?
questions.e: Pairs 1, 2 and 3 are correct. Scan and Share was developed by the National Health Authority for QR-based OPD registration and digital queue tokens. BODH trains AI models without exposing raw patient data, and SAHI, also launched in 2026, sets ethics and governance rules for AI in healthcare.

questions.q:
With reference to registries under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, consider the following statements:
1. The Healthcare Professionals Registry includes AYUSH practitioners.
2. The Health Facility Registry covers only government hospitals.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only statement 1 is correct; the professionals registry covers doctors, dentists, nurses and AYUSH practitioners. The facility registry lists both public and private hospitals, clinics, labs, imaging centres and pharmacies. Onboarding private providers, for instance through the 'Microsite Project', is a key strategy for expanding the mission.
